description: MInistry of Transport & Civil Aviation - Notify the Civil Aviation (Licencing of Personnel and Training Institutions) Regulation of 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation under the Civil Aviation Act, establishing licensing requirements and procedures for aviation personnel and training institutions. It constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for new regulations and regulatory compliance requirements.
